statusText: Mapped policy state: BLOCK_NEW_BASE_ENTRIES. Tail remains elevated because NQ is still about 1% below settlement near premarket lows while volatility, yields, oil and technology weakness are aligned; lack of a fresh extension limits the current score.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: BLOCK_NEW_BASE_ENTRIES; the elevated state reflects persistent downside structure and aligned cross-asset pressure, with escalation dependent on continued session-extreme holding or failed retracements.
headline: NQ remains near premarket lows as rates, oil and tech pressure stay aligned
body: At the assessment cutoff, Nasdaq-100 futures were around 29,210-29,221, roughly 1% below the 29,513 prior settlement, while VIX was near 15.9. Reuters reported the U.S. 10-year yield around 4.79% and Brent above $92. Fresh Finviz context from 10:50 UTC showed all eight covered megacaps negative and technology/semiconductor weakness, used only as supplementary confirmation.

lookbackSummary: Across the prior 24 clock-hours, Tail ranged from 19% to 31%. Conditions shifted from event/whipsaw and mixed states into an elevated trend-down regime during the U.S. premarket as NQ weakened materially; Stress remained 97-99%.
outlookSummary: Current Tail is elevated at 31% because NQ remains near premarket lows with VIX, Treasury yields, oil and technology weakness aligned. Conditional Tail peaks at 39% at 14:00 UTC only if the opening/data sequence produces persistent one-way repricing or failed retracements; orderly rotation would reduce risk.

forecast.analysis: NQ remains about 1% below settlement near the lower end of the premarket range, while VIX, Treasury yields, oil and broad tech weakness remain aligned. The absence of a fresh extension tempers Tail despite persistent downside structure.

news.title: Wall St futures kick off September under pressure as yields, oil prices rise
Oil up around 2% as renewed US-Iran strikes stoke supply fears

forecast.analysis: Barr at 13:05 UTC and the approach to the U.S. cash open create a high-sensitivity handoff. Tail stays elevated and reaches the top of the band only if the existing downside structure survives rebounds into the opening auction.

The 14:00 UTC JOLTS, ISM Manufacturing and Construction Spending cluster is the peak conditional hour. High Tail requires one-way repricing after the releases or repeated failed retracements; a two-sided response would reduce it.

After the data cluster, Tail remains elevated if the first impulse persists through shallow or failed pullbacks. A meaningful rotation away from session extremes would move the path back toward WATCH conditions.

A delayed second leg remains possible if NQ stays near session lows while yields, oil and technology remain aligned. Visible mean reversion and widening two-sided trade would weaken the trend-down case.
Late-morning U.S. risk stays elevated if weak rebounds continue to fail. If price rotates through the morning range and cross-asset pressure eases, Tail should compress toward WATCH.
Early-afternoon Tail falls to WATCH in the base case as event shock decays. Renewed extension after a weak rebound would invalidate that easing and return the state to elevated.
Mid-afternoon conditions are expected to be two-sided unless a fresh catalyst restarts directional efficiency. Holding away from extremes would support continued Tail normalization.
Approaching power hour, WATCH remains appropriate if the session has developed meaningful retracements. A renewed one-way push with weak pullbacks would raise Tail again.
Power-hour risk stays in WATCH because late-session positioning can amplify moves. Tail would rise only if the closing phase becomes directionally efficient with failed counter-moves.
The U.S. close transition keeps residual WATCH risk. A balanced close and reduced cross-asset pressure would favor further normalization; persistent extreme holding would keep Tail elevated.
Post-close conditions should reduce immediate path risk if the cash session ends with two-sided structure. Geopolitical and rate-sensitive headline risk keeps Tail from falling fully to low.
Early Asia hours carry lower immediate Tail if no fresh geopolitical escalation appears. Stress remains high because oil and global yields can reprice quickly even without persistent NQ direction.
Asia trading is expected to remain lower-Tail absent a new catalyst. Thin liquidity can magnify moves, but persistent mean-reversion failure is not the base case.
Overnight Tail remains low if NQ continues to rotate rather than extend. A new Middle East or rates shock would be the main path-changing risk.
Late-Asia conditions remain low-Tail in the base case. The key checkpoint is whether any overnight move develops repeated extension instead of ordinary retracement.
Ahead of Europe, Tail edges higher modestly as liquidity and cross-asset participation build. Directional persistence would still need confirmation before a higher regime is justified.
European opening activity can reintroduce WATCH conditions if rates, oil and technology signals realign. Two-sided futures trade would keep the increase contained.
The European morning keeps WATCH risk as global rates and energy markets regain liquidity. Tail rises only if NQ begins holding near overnight extremes with shallow pullbacks.
WATCH persists through the European morning if cross-asset pressure remains active. A stable rebound structure would argue against escalation.
Late-European conditions remain WATCH ahead of the next U.S. data cycle. Without fresh directional efficiency, Tail should stay below the elevated threshold.
The U.S. premarket handoff can increase sensitivity to labor-market expectations. Tail remains WATCH unless price action begins extending one-way with weak retracements.
Risk edges higher as the next U.S. labor-data window approaches. The score remains conditional on observed structure; scheduled data alone does not establish a persistent Tail path.
Ahead of the next U.S. release window, WATCH remains the base state. Tail would move higher only if fresh price action and cross-assets align into persistent directional repricing.

forecastDetail.comment: Current downside structure remains elevated: NQ is near premarket lows with VIX, yields, oil and technology pressure aligned, but without a fresh extension.
Barr and the cash-open handoff raise sensitivity; the elevated score assumes the downside structure persists through rebounds into the opening auction.
Peak conditional hour: JOLTS, ISM Manufacturing and Construction Spending can lift Tail only if post-release price action becomes one-way or retracements fail.
Post-data Tail remains elevated only if the initial move extends through shallow or failed pullbacks; meaningful rotation would reduce the state.
Delayed-second-leg risk persists if NQ remains near lows with cross-assets aligned; visible mean reversion would weaken the trend-down path.
Late-morning risk stays elevated if weak rebounds continue failing, while broader two-sided rotation would compress Tail toward WATCH.
